checkpoints.label: Deployment
checkpoints.title: A backfield start, not a reserve arrival
checkpoints.alt: Overhead opening board. Magnus is near the top edge, a white transport sits by the upper diagonal ruin, and purple vehicles are in the lower half.
visible: Magnus is already on the table near the upper edge. The white transport is beside the upper diagonal ruin.
Purple transports and large dark models occupy the lower half. The central lanes are comparatively open.
checkpoints.interpretation: Use this as the positional baseline: the later right-flank appearance of Magnus is movement from an on-table start, not evidence of a deep strike.
checkpoints.unknown: Exact deployment order, legal visibility and unit footprints cannot be recovered from this frame. The complete army list has not been independently read.

checkpoints.label: Right-flank commitment
checkpoints.title: Magnus moves into the right-side fight
checkpoints.alt: Overhead board at 1 hour 15 minutes. Magnus is below the upper-right ruin; purple transports have advanced on both flanks.
visible: Magnus is now below the upper-right ruin, substantially farther down the board than in the opening frame.
Purple transports have advanced on the left and right; infantry extend into the middle lanes.

reported.text: Commentators discuss Magnus lining up the Defiler and a possible Rhino charge. Their initial movement explanation is corrected during the discussion; the proposed charge is not proof it happened.

checkpoints.interpretation: The opening concentrates threat on the right rather than spreading Magnus across the centre. The video supports the commitment; it does not establish that this is safe against Knights.
checkpoints.unknown: A camera still cannot establish the exact 24-inch check, line of sight or all charge options.

checkpoints.label: Combined fire
checkpoints.title: Follow-up fire matters: not a Magnus solo kill
checkpoints.alt: Broadcast scoring panel shows Thousand Sons 14 and Emperor’s Children 20, including four No Prisoners points.
visible: The scoring panel now shows 14–20 and four points under No Prisoners for Thousand Sons.
This is a scoreboard/room shot, not an overhead casualty record.

reported.text: The commentary first calls the Defiler dead, then corrects that call after Magnus shoots. Subsequent shooting includes the Terminators and missile racks; around 1:33:23 the Defiler is called destroyed.

checkpoints.interpretation: Keep a follow-up damage plan. The reported sequence is combined shooting finishing the target, not evidence that Magnus reliably removes it alone.
checkpoints.unknown: The still does not prove which attack killed the Defiler, exact weapon allocation, or the full casualties. Those claims rely on the audio sequence.

checkpoints.label: Counterattack survives
checkpoints.title: Magnus is still present after the counterattack
checkpoints.alt: Overhead board at 2 hours 5 minutes. Magnus and nearby infantry crowd the upper-right flank beside a purple transport.
visible: Magnus remains beside the upper-right ruin, with several infantry bases immediately around him.
The right-side purple transport is alongside that fight. Another purple transport is now beside the upper-left ruin.

reported.text: Commentators describe damage into Magnus, including Daemonette attacks, and report him down to four wounds. They also discuss Scarab Occult Terminators still fighting near a Rhino. Exact surviving model counts are not clear.

checkpoints.interpretation: The retaliation has not immediately removed Magnus. Survival preserves a threat on that flank, but the reported four wounds make this a narrow escape, not a demonstration of invulnerability.
checkpoints.unknown: Four wounds is a commentary report, not a clearly readable wound marker. Other casualties and the precise fight order remain incomplete.

checkpoints.label: The board opens up
checkpoints.title: Support moves right; the score gap narrows
checkpoints.alt: Midgame overhead board. The white transport has moved toward the right-side ruin, infantry extend to the centre, and the score is 26–28.
visible: The white transport has moved from the upper diagonal ruin toward the right-centre. Infantry extend left from it toward the middle.
Magnus remains on the right. Infantry also line the right edge of the upper-left ruin. The overlay reads 26–28.
checkpoints.interpretation: The right-flank engagement has drawn supporting pieces forward while the displayed deficit has narrowed. This is visible redistribution, not proof of a particular objective-control calculation.
checkpoints.unknown: The transport’s cargo, infantry identities and objective ownership cannot all be established. Fewer visible bases alone do not prove they were destroyed.

checkpoints.label: Late-board conversion
checkpoints.title: A much thinner board; Thousand Sons edge ahead
checkpoints.alt: Late-game overhead board, now much more sparsely occupied. The white transport is beside the central-right ruin and a purple transport remains at the upper-left edge. Overlay 46–45.
visible: Far fewer infantry bases are visible than in the midgame view. The white transport is farther down, beside the central-right ruin.
A purple transport is at the upper-left edge. The broadcast score has moved to 46–45.

reported.text: Shortly after this frame, commentary says Emperor’s Children have been tabled and the turn-five score has been entered. The announced finish is 78–45.

checkpoints.interpretation: This is the transition from a close displayed score to endgame scoring. Do not read the eventual 33-point win as evidence that the middle turns were comfortable.
checkpoints.unknown: There is a substantial sampling gap after the previous overhead. It does not support an exact turn-three casualty ledger or a reconstruction of every scoring action.

checkpoints.label: Result & debrief
checkpoints.title: 78–45, with turn-five scoring entered at the finish
checkpoints.alt: Players standing beside the table after the game. The broadcast scoreboard shows Alex Fowler 78, Frasier Parry 45; the turn label still reads bottom turn 4.
visible: The overlay shows Alex Fowler 78, Frasier Parry 45. Players are no longer in an active overhead board sequence.
The turn label still reads bottom turn 4: the overlay should not be treated as a perfect event log.

reported.text: The debrief discusses an attack intended to remove both Magnus and the Scarabs that removed neither. It also discusses the surviving Sorcerer, the Crystal still being available, and the order of the Daemonette attacks.

checkpoints.interpretation: The useful review question is target allocation: what was left alive to answer the counterattack? The debrief supports that question, not a universal instruction to expose Magnus early.
checkpoints.unknown: The closing total includes endgame/turn-five scoring entered after the reported elimination. A fully played fifth turn is not evidenced. The index agrees with the final score.

queue.title: The Priority Assets mirror
queue.note: Indexed Thousand Sons win, 94–78. Best next review for your mission: Grand Coven versus Legion of Excess / Warptide, Priority Assets on both sides. Not Knights.
